canonical_name: No Information Sharing on Adverse Events
description: Information on adverse events is not provided to authorized staff and tools.
applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity detection capabilities Security operations and monitoring teams Threat detection and analysis functions Organizations with continuous monitoring requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Organizations should establish processes to share relevant information about adverse events with appropriate internal stakeholders (security teams, incident responders, management) and automated security tools (SIEM, SOAR, threat intelligence platforms). This sharing should follow established authorization protocols and enable coordinated detection and response activities.
